name: Blue-Top Steering Gears Inc.
old_description: In 2011, Ryan (Myron's son), purchased the business.  During that time Ryan re-established the business in Stanton, North Dakota. He reorganized and started pushing the business area across the United States.  Ryan's experience re-manufacturing steering gears with another large company in Seattle, Washington helped him with the understanding of many different types of steering components and the re-manufacturing process.  With the new location, better facilities, and a lot of years ahead, he pushed harder expanding sales from coast to coast. By this time Ryan had updated most of the equipment and had purchased more machining equipment to be able to keep all work in-house.  In 2017 Blue-Top Steering expanded into re-manufacturing steering valves and steering cylinders to add to the service abilities.  Since 2017 the business has grown every month as more people look to have a quality product installed on their vehicle to keep them steering straight down the road.
about:
Blue-Top Steering Gears Inc. operates from Stanton, North Dakota. In 2011, Ryan, son of the previous owner Myron, purchased the business and re-established it in Stanton. Ryan brought experience from remanufacturing steering gears with a large company in Seattle, Washington, giving him deep knowledge of steering components and processes.

The company remanufactures steering gears, steering valves, and steering cylinders for a wide range of light- and heavy-duty trucks. All machining and assembly work is kept in-house using updated equipment. The product catalog includes hundreds of part numbers covering applications such as 1994–2002 Dodge Ram 1500/2500/3500, 1999–2007 Chevrolet 1500/2500HD/3500HD, 1968–1979 Ford F-Series, and 1980–1986 Jeep CJ models.

Blue-Top serves the automotive aftermarket, supplying repair shops, fleet operators, and individual vehicle owners across the United States. Its rebuild-and-return program accepts OEM cores for remanufacturing, and the company ships stocked units nationwide.

Ryan’s background in large-scale steering gear remanufacturing drove the focus on quality and in-house control. Since adding steering valves and cylinders in 2017, the business has grown steadily as customers seek reliable, OEM-quality steering components.
